phase: initial (frozen, written before any TLC/Go execution)
overall_reason: The update makes three semantic contract changes that the old suite encodes the opposite way: (1) learners now cast votes (raft.go:933-950, raft_test.go:381-397), so VoteDecisionEligibility and the grant half of LearnerEligibility forbid required behavior; (2) RawNode.Ready() now accepts the Ready (clears msgs/readStates) and Advance() no longer clears them (rawnode.go:119-133, rawnode_test.go:928-960), so ReadyOwnership's RawNode branch is inverted and the lostReads observer behind ReadyAccounting assumes Advance-clears semantics; (3) snapshot restore and construction now rebuild the full joint ConfState via confchange.Restore (raft.go:321-367,1431-1446; confchange/restore.go:111-155), which the old suite already demands through JointSnapshotRecovery/ConfigurationOrigin (old model deliberately kept the lossy projection to show the violation). Those properties are kept; the model's RestoreProjection becomes the identity. One new obligation (Advance must not drop outbox/readStates created after Ready) and one new member-restore obligation are added; the latter is expected to expose an implementation defect (restore() membership check ignores VotersOutgoing). Unaffected safety properties are kept as controls.

suspected_defects.description: raft.restore membership check scans only cs.Voters and cs.Learners (new/source/raft.go:1401-1420); a member of only the outgoing half (VotersOutgoing, incl. LearnersNext demotions) ignores a joint snapshot, contradicting raft.go:1398-1400 intent and raft_test.go:2789-2796 ('permanently cut off'). Must not be hidden by weakening SnapshotMemberRestore.

TestLearnerCanVote assertion 'msg.Type != pb.MsgVoteResp && !msg.Reject' (raft_test.go:394) is vacuous for a rejecting MsgVoteResp; requirement relies on the raft.go:933-950 comment plus the test's intent/name.
lostReads observer encodes the old Advance-clears implementation; must be migrated, not used as requirement.
